{{Vanilla|Gold Ore}}
{{Infobox auto}}
'''Native gold''' is the renamed gold ore.

The deepslate variant is '''native deepslate gold'''.

== Obtaining ==
=== Natural generation ===
As vanilla gold ore.

=== Breaking ===
Mined with a pickaxe (see [[Tools#Mining levels]]), it drops 1 raw gold; adamant tools drop a gold ingot. Needs an iron or better pickaxe. Silk Touch drops the block.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/blocks/gold_ore.json}}</ref>

Native deepslate gold applies [[Fortune]] and the [[Electrum equipment|electrum]] intrinsic to the raw gold, one after the other, like other ores.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/blocks/deepslate_gold_ore.json}}</ref> The raw gold entry of stone native gold is still written in the 26.2 loot format (<code>functions</code> instead of <code>modifier</code>), which Minecraft 26.3 doesn't read, so its raw gold gets neither bonus and is always 1. See [[Known bugs]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/blocks/gold_ore.json}}</ref> Gold ingots from adamant tools get the Fortune and electrum bonuses from both blocks.

== History ==
{{History|
{{History line|1.12.3|The table was corrected so that Fortune is no longer applied twice and the electrum intrinsic is included, as for native deepslate gold.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/blocks/gold_ore.json}}</ref>}}
{{History line|1.12.6-alpha|The raw gold entry of stone native gold is left in the 26.2 loot format, so Fortune and the electrum intrinsic no longer add raw gold.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/blocks/gold_ore.json}}</ref>}}
}}
